name: Roasted Lamb
description: A slow-roasted lamb recipe with a flavorful garlic and rosemary paste, perfect for a tender and aromatic main course.

recipeInstructions.text: Make a paste with olive oil, butter, garlic, and rosemary.
Make small holes in the lamb and insert garlic cloves or pieces.
Smear the lamb with the prepared paste.
Sprinkle with flour and place in a roasting pan.
Add a scant amount of water to the pan and sprinkle rosemary on top.
Roast slowly at 250°F to 300°F for 6 to 7 hours or until done.
Remove the lid near the end to brown the lamb.

keywords: roasted lamb, garlic and rosemary, slow cooking

_similar.name: South African Lamb
_similar.description: A flavorful lamb stew with dried fruits, curry powder, and orange juice, simmered to tender perfection.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups chopped dried fruit (apples, apricots, raisins, etc.)
Rice, bulgar, or couscous for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Combine dried fruit, orange juice, and hot water. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours to soak.
Brown the lamb cubes and drain on paper towels.
Sauté the chopped onion until soft, then reduce heat to low and stir in curry powder.
Add the soaked fruit and 1 cup of soaking liquid to the pan. Stir in vinegar, sugar, and tomato paste.
Return the browned lamb to the pan, cover, and simmer for 1 hour.
Uncover and allow the liquid to reduce to desired consistency.
Serve with rice, bulgar, or couscous.

_similar.keywords: South African lamb, lamb stew, curry lamb, dried fruit

_similar.name: Rosemary Shipwreck Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, and a tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine beef, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place potatoes in the bottom of a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Top potatoes with chopped onion.
Cover onion layer with the beef mixture.
Spoon pork and beans over the beef layer.
Pour tomato soup over the pork and beans.
Cover the casserole and bake for 1 hour or until done.

_similar.keywords: shipwreck casserole, ground beef, potato casserole

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish
